blocks.text: Unified customer support across chat, email, and social - with AI

Crisp combines multi-channel support with a clean, modern interface that does not overwhelm small teams. It consolidates live chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger into a single shared inbox - so your team never has to switch between platforms to handle customer conversations.

The AI layer is practical rather than flashy. It suggests responses based on previous conversations and your knowledge base, summarizes long threads, and can handle common queries autonomously. For small support teams, this multiplies their effective capacity without complex setup.

Crisp's knowledge base builder helps you create self-service documentation that both customers and the AI reference. Articles you write reduce tickets directly, and the AI uses them to answer questions - a compounding investment in support efficiency.
Chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger in one view
Suggested replies and autonomous handling of common queries
Self-service help center that feeds the AI response system
Visual bot builder for qualifying leads and routing conversations
See and interact with your customer's screen in real-time
Track customer data and conversation history across touchpoints

Crisp offers the best value for small teams that need multi-channel support. The free tier is genuinely usable, and the paid plans are significantly cheaper than Intercom while covering the essentials.
Our team can integrate Crisp into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
